title: Radford, VA - 2 Car Garage - Custom Color Epoxy Flake System
description:
This brand new home in Heron's Landing in Radford, VA got our Premium Epoxy Flake system installed in the garage. The client chose a custom color blend to match the finishes on their new home.

We also brought the epoxy system up onto the walls to create a seamless cove base - the client can hose out their garage without having to worry about getting the walls wet!
